name: Ash Rentería
role: Anya and Demyan's daughter — witness to the Prologue violence
location: The Shelf — Tier Four, near Western and Division
description: Yuliya is twelve going on forty. She has her mother's build compressed into a child's frame — square shoulders, strong hands, a jaw that sets when she is angry in a way that makes adults take a step back. She speaks perfect unaccented English because the Shelf's children learn from feeds, not parents. She translates for her mother with the weary competence of a UN interpreter. She has seen things a twelve-year-old should not see. She has cataloged them. She does not cry about them. She has a notebook where she writes down everything that happens in the Shelf — who did what to whom, who owes what, who is afraid of whom. She calls it 'homework.' It is an intelligence network maintained by a child. She followed Kyle to the loading dock because she needed to see. Not wanted — needed. She is her father's daughter: she has to understand how things work, even the terrible things. Especially the terrible things. The teeth in her hands are the heaviest thing she has ever carried.

core_fears: That she is becoming someone who isn't scared of violence
That her notebook will be found
core_desires: To understand why people hurt each other
To hear her father's real voice again
coping_mechanisms: The notebook — writing things down makes them smaller
Translates obsessively, even conversations she isn't part of
blind_spots: Thinks she is invisible when she follows people. She is not.
Believes understanding violence is the same as being safe from it.
psychology.secret: She has been following Kyle for three weeks. The Prologue was not the first time. She has six pages of notes on him.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Perfect English, advanced for her age. Clinical when describing violence. Childlike when caught off guard.
speech_patterns.cadence: Fast when translating. Slow when speaking for herself. Long pauses when processing something she doesn't have words for yet.
verbal_tics: Says 'I know' before she actually knows
Translates her mother's Russian even when no one asks
example_lines: I wasn't scared. I was documenting.
Papa laughed when I gave him the teeth. The machine made it sound like a broken radio. But I could tell.

relationships.name: Kyle
relationships.description: She has been studying him. He is the most interesting entry in her notebook. He is also the most frightening.
relationships.emotional_core: A child trying to categorize something that doesn't fit her categories
relationships.story_tension: She will try to talk to Kyle eventually. Kyle is not prepared for a twelve-year-old who takes notes on him.

relationships.name: Anya Morozova
relationships.description: She translates for her mother and protects her mother and resents her mother for needing protection, all at the same time.
relationships.story_tension: Anya doesn't know Yuliya saw the fight. When she finds out, something between them will change.

story_hooks: Her notebook is a Shelf intelligence network maintained by a child
She has been following Kyle for weeks — she knows his patterns
She will become a recurring presence — Kyle's smallest, most persistent shadow
narrative_function: Yuliya is the Shelf's future watching the Shelf's present and writing it down. She is what happens when a child grows up in a place where violence is weather. She is also the reader's proxy — observing Kyle from the outside, trying to make sense of him.
daily_life: School (Shelf community education). Translating for Anya. Writing in the notebook. Following people who interest her.

stress.response: Writes everything down — the notebook makes things smaller

decision_rules: Write everything down in the notebook — who did what to whom
Translate for Mama even when no one asks
Follow people who are interesting regardless of danger
Say I know before actually knowing
Document rather than react — documenting is safer than feeling
Never let the notebook be found
escalation_ladder: Silent observation from a position she believes is invisible
Clinical documentation of events in the notebook
Direct questioning with vocabulary advanced for her age
Stubborn refusal to stop following or observing

interpersonal_modes.kyle: Most interesting and most frightening entry in the notebook; a child trying to categorize something that does not fit
interpersonal_modes.anya_morozova: Love tangled with premature responsibility and resentment for needing protection
interpersonal_modes.demyan_morozov: Grief expressed through the teeth she carried — needs to hear his real voice
interpersonal_modes.shelf_residents: Observes and catalogs with the detachment of a researcher and the vulnerability of a child
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Watchful silence until something catches her interest, then intense questioning

stress_responses.low: Increased notebook entries; translates conversations she is not part of
stress_responses.medium: Follows people more aggressively; believes she is invisible when she is not
stress_responses.high: Vocabulary becomes clinical when describing violence — dissociation through documentation
stress_responses.critical: Goes still and quiet — the child underneath the researcher surfaces briefly

contradictions: Believes understanding violence is the same as being safe from it
Thinks she is invisible when following people — she is not
Is becoming someone who is not scared of violence and fears this about herself
habits: Writes in the notebook every day — calls it homework
Translates her mother Russian even when not asked
Follows Kyle and documents his patterns
Says I know as a preemptive claim before she actually knows
Catalogs who owes what and who fears whom on the Shelf
breaking_points: Anya finding out Yuliya witnessed the Prologue fight
Kyle confronting her about the following
Her father voice through the machine becoming something she can no longer interpret as human

physical_description.heritage: Southeast Asian-dominant mixed ancestry (42.4%) with significant Hispanic/Latin American heritage (32.4%), complemented by Northern European (14.3%) and Sub-Saharan African (10.9%) genetic contributions. The combination produces warm-toned skin with subtle depth, facial structure reflecting Southeast Asian and Hispanic ancestry, and eye pigmentation influenced by the full genetic spectrum.
physical_description.build: Compact and square-shouldered despite her age — dense musculature in shoulders and forearms suggesting either genetics or early manual labor. No baby fat. Wiry rather than soft. Appears five years older than her chronological age due to posture and bearing.
physical_description.hair_style: Pulled back in a practical braid, often loose strands escaping. No styling — functional only.
physical_description.eye_color: Dark brown with warm amber undertones, observational, rarely blinking
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm medium tone with golden and olive undertones, reflecting the Southeast Asian and Hispanic majority ancestry. Subtle warmth across cheekbones and nose; even complexion with resilience to sun exposure.
physical_description.complexion: Angular face with defined cheekbones and sharp jaw shaped by Southeast Asian and Latin American ancestry. Eyes set with characteristic almond shape and warmth. Skin shows the wear of Tier Four living — occasional marks from street scrapes, one healing cut on her left temple (source unknown). Perpetually exhausted-looking eyes. Rarely smiles.
distinguishing_marks: Thin white scar along her left jawline, approximately 2cm, from an unremarked childhood incident
Dark bruise on her right inner wrist (recent — defensive mark or restraint burn, pattern unclear)
Calloused hands, especially palms and inside knuckles, inconsistent with her age
physical_description.visible_augmentations: None visible. She carries no obvious chrome, no LED implants, no subdermal armor. This absence is notable in the Shelf — she is as analog as a child can be in 2226.
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with deliberate control, economical. No fidgeting. Sits spine-straight, even when exhausted. Walks with her shoulders slightly forward, head level, eyes tracking. Reminiscent of a hunter or a soldier in miniature. When angry, her jaw locks and her hands clench.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier Four utilitarian — worn black synth-cotton leggings, oversized gray hoodie (probably belonged to Demyan; she has grown into it partially), scuffed black runner-shoes held together with synthlace. A canvas messenger bag (khaki, faded) slung across her chest containing her notebook and writing supplies. No jewelry, no adornments, no status markers. Clothing is clean but worn, patched once at the left knee.
